snippet.title: Nocciolino and the creamy adventures - Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/domurosoft/nocciolino-and-the-creamy-adventure-a-new-platform-game
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4799340/Nocciolino__The_Creamy_Adventure/

After two years of development, we're ready to announce what we've been working on: Nocciolino & The Creamy Adventure, a 3D action-adventure platformer where the world reacts to everything you do.

You play as Nocciolino, a super-strong but endearingly clumsy kid who has to save his world from the evil Chef, who wants to steal its hazelnuts for wicked purposes.

- A world that reacts: punch enemies into chain reactions, smash crates and fences, and use gadgets that do more than one thing. The water hose, for example, can blast enemies, grow platforms, or fill containers to solve puzzles.
- An adventure worth exploring: hidden paths and shortcuts reward you with a special currency, to spend at the shops of quirky characters on new paths, items and upgrades.
- A cast with personality: funny characters, dialogue, and a villain who needs to be stopped.
- Hazelnut magic: a wizard turns the hazelnuts of Nocciolino's world into a powerful cream that can even power a magic train, and the evil Chef wants to steal them.

Roll, bounce, and interact with a fully physics-driven world in this vibrant 3D platforming adventure! Take control of Nocciolino and thwart the sinister Chef's plans. Explore dynamic levels where every object responds to your touch, talk to a cast of wacky characters, and unlock game-changing gadgets to conquer impossible obstacles. It's time to smash through enemies and uncover secrets using the ultimate power of hazelnut magic! #indiegame #platformer #steamgame #wishlistnow #Nocciolino #indiedev #adventuregame #pcgaming
